applications.workflow: Open all-white 256x256 RGB PNG, draw two black strokes in GUI, save PNG, save Krita native KRZ archive, exit and reopen KRZ via service; X painting and paint layer preserved. PNG decoded independently: 15949 black pixels, 48716 white pixels. Native archive CRC, mimetype, image dimensions and paint layer structure verified.
